engine_decision: Unity 6000.3.24f1; intended renderer illustrated 2.5D; source3D remains an opt-in engineering experiment whose visual style was rejected
notes: The intended character presentation is illustrated 2.5D in the original Kai manhwa art direction. The generic rendered 3D appearance was rejected.
A shared technical 3D source now exists with licensed CC0 base data and deterministic export. Its structure can guide authoring, but it is not an accepted visual target or production asset pack.
All fourteen male/female source appearances are explicitly user-approved with no remaining art corrections. All production fits remain not selectable and not runtime usable.

The fourteen hash-bound appearance approvals preserve immutable source masters. They do not establish separate production layers, equipment fits, animation or directional exports. Earlier decisions remain in review history.
Fitness measurements remain outside this appearance contract. Presets do not imply health, fitness, capability, workout prescriptions or combat strength and are never inferred from measurements.
Rendered sprite appearances can use only exported and verified fit variants. Source morphs do not imply continuous sprite customization.
Legacy proposal IDs and the existing proof_male_athletic runtime IDs remain traceable. They are not aliases for the new seven presets.
Nullable face/palette IDs remain unresolved authoring placeholders and are not runtime fallback selections.

reference_style.approval_scope: Illustrated style and all fourteen exact selected source appearances are user-approved. Production layers, equipment fits, animation and runtime readiness remain unverified and unavailable.

identifiers.asset_id: Stable internal ID; never derive identity from a translated label or filename.

identifiers.fit_family_id: Approved body presentation, size and muscle-definition combination with matching clothing fits.
identifiers.action_id: Shared semantic action across portrait, gym and tower representations; clips can differ by fit family.
identifiers.clip_id: A versioned, authored motion for an action, skeleton and fit family.
identifiers.atlas_id: Versioned exported atlas or layer bundle; absent until an export exists.
identifiers.mask_id: Versioned skin, hair, clothing or occlusion mask tied to the same fit, direction, clip and frame.
identifiers.source_asset_id: Provenance record for an actual owned or licensed source; null for an unrendered proposal.

release_invariants: Only explicitly approved revisions enter a window composite.
An equip operation requires a verified fit family, compatible skeleton and all necessary export records.
Headgear declares and validates hair visibility for the selected hairstyle.
Color masks may not modify unrelated surfaces.
Every directional clip has stable frame registration and verified occlusion.
An item cannot become available merely because its intended fit is listed.
Missing rights, export settings, approvals or sources keep an asset unavailable for release.

body_parts_proposed.registration: Shared rig/bind pose or synchronized frame registration; matching direction, canvas, pivots and attachment anchors.
body_parts_proposed.runtime_packing: Authoring parts may be packed into atlases; this list does not require a texture or draw call for every part.
body_parts_proposed.distant_face: A combined low-detail face may represent the same appearance recipe in distant gameplay.

new_preset_requires: approved art direction and facial identity
body_preset_authoring_contract.fat_muscular_interpretation: Large fat mass, substantial soft belly and fuller waist together with visible, proportionate muscular form; do not inflate arms beyond the chosen head/body proportions or attach health labels or stats.
body_preset_authoring_contract.legacy_policy: Legacy placeholder and runtime proof IDs remain separate and must not silently map to these seven IDs.
body_preset_authoring_contract.style_reference_body_interpretation: The approved illustrated-style-r1 proof reads as muscular and must not be silently labeled normal.
body_preset_authoring_contract.female_proportion_direction: SoloGym-specific art direction: female muscle volume remains smaller than corresponding male presets, with restrained arm and leg size and moderate strength cues; not a universal biological claim.

recorded_user_art_feedback.nonmuscular_skinny_chubby: Use softer arms with less muscular form and definition; preserve the explicitly approved female skinny master.
recorded_user_art_feedback.male_normal: Mildly fuller body with no visible abs.
recorded_user_art_feedback.male_fat: Fuller soft chest and larger belly.
recorded_user_art_feedback.male_fat_muscular: Smaller, proportionate arms while retaining fat mass and muscular traits.
recorded_user_art_feedback.female_fat: Softer and slightly slimmer arms while retaining a protruding belly; do not flatten the stomach.
recorded_user_art_feedback.female_fat_muscular: Modestly smaller bust while preserving the established body and restrained muscle treatment.
recorded_user_art_feedback.female_muscular: Historical supplement requested a little more muscle while keeping proportionate limbs and smaller muscle volume than male muscular. The selected female-muscular r3 is now explicitly approved.
recorded_user_art_feedback.earlier_directions_status: All earlier corrections have been achieved in the fourteen approved source appearances. Retain these historical rules for future derived assets; do not continue revising approved masters.

achieved_historical_corrections.contour_rule: Reduce the actual limb contour size where requested; changing only painted shading is insufficient.
achieved_historical_corrections.male_chubby: Narrow upper arms, which remained almost head-width in r2; keep the softer chubby torso.
achieved_historical_corrections.male_fat: Narrow oversized arms and replace muscular pectoral forms with soft chest volume, retaining the full belly. This request is for male-fat, not approved male-fat_muscular r2.
achieved_historical_corrections.female_fat: Reduce thigh and calf bulk and muscular form while retaining the fat silhouette and protruding belly.
